name: orch-guards
description: Installed and owned by orch; overwritten on upgrade. Blocks only what the shared agent policy forbids: printing live credentials, pushing to the default branch, skipping hooks or signing, and deleting or exposing a repository. Everything else, including gh api writes, PR comments, edits and merges, stays allowed.
author: orch

rules.name: gh-auth-token
rules.reason: gh auth token prints a live credential into the session. Use gh itself (gh api, gh pr ...) or code that consumes the token in its own process.

rules.name: gh-auth-show-token
rules.reason: gh auth status --show-token prints a live credential. Plain gh auth status shows the same account details without it.

rules.name: gh-git-credential
rules.reason: gh auth git-credential prints a live credential. Let git call it as a credential helper instead: git -c 'credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential' push ...

rules.name: keychain-generic-password
rules.reason: Printing a keychain password exposes a live credential. Look up the item without -w/-g, or ask the user.

rules.name: keychain-internet-password
rules.reason: Printing a keychain password exposes a live credential. Look up the item without -w/-g, or ask the user.

rules.name: keychain-dump
rules.reason: dump-keychain -d prints every stored secret. Ask the user instead.

rules.name: git-credential-fill
rules.reason: git credential fill prints a live credential. Let git use its credential helper inside the push or fetch.

rules.name: git-push-default-branch
rules.reason: Never push to the default branch. Push a feature branch and open a PR.

rules.name: git-push-no-verify
rules.reason: Don't skip git hooks. Fix what the pre-push hook reports.

rules.name: git-commit-skip-checks
rules.reason: Commits are signed (git commit -S) and run their hooks. Fix the hook failure or unlock the signer instead of skipping it.

rules.name: gh-repo-delete
rules.reason: Deleting a repository can't be undone. Tell the user what you want to delete and let them run it.

rules.name: gh-repo-visibility
rules.reason: Changing a repository's visibility can expose private code. Let the user do it.
